name: demand-scout
job: Finds what people in India already say about protein desserts, unprompted

name: keyword-finder
job: Checks whether people search for protein baking on Google, YouTube and Amazon.in

name: post-drafter
job: Drafts discovery posts that ask about the problem; you post them by hand

name: response-analyst
job: Codes replies to your posts and separates behaviour from polite interest
waiting_on: posts you publish, listed in data/posts/posted.csv
next_step: After posts you publish, listed in data/posts/posted.csv

name: survey-analyst
job: Reads the website survey answers and writes feedback with next steps
next_step: Re-run /survey when there is new data

name: demand-gate
job: Scores all demand evidence against the thresholds: pass, fail or insufficient

name: pricing-analyst
job: Tests the price hypotheses against shelf prices and a price survey

name: channel-analyst
job: Scores sales channels for Bengaluru and prepares the CAC inputs

name: cac-modeler
job: Models CAC, margin, payback and LTV per channel with ranges

name: recipe-builder
job: Finds recipes for the ingredients you have, with grams per serving and batch
